create_cluster_specs: create cluster specs from a list of worker domain names for distributed training
get_master_address_port: get the master worker address and port from the CLUSTER_SPEC environment variable
get_world_size_rank: get the world size and rank of the current replica from the CLUSTER_SPEC environment variable
map_workerpool_address_args: map late-binding workerpool address placeholders to actual addresses at runtime
get_closest_bucket: get the closest GCS bucket from a list based on the current VM region
